decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Application Form, Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Report, Structural Design Philosophy, Construction Method Statement, 13/025-01-Sheet 1, 13/025-01-Sheet 2, 13/025-01-Sheet 3, 13/025-01-Sheet 4, 13/025-02-Sheet 1, 13/025-02-Sheet 2, 13/025-02-Sheet 3, Received 9 September 2013 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used for sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 6 - The construction work and development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the Flood Risk Report, Structural Design Philosophy and Construction Method Statement, Received 9 September 2013.

Condition : 7 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
description: Formation of enlarged basement storey together with new lightwells on front and rear elevations.
